# Retained official boundary diagnostic

Two complete, unmodified IGN feature geometries (Bellver de Cerdanya and
Prullans), extracted from the 19 October 2026 retained API snapshot. This is
**official geography**, not observed housing data. It is not the full source
response or a synthetic test polygon. `provenance.json` pins extract/geometry
hashes, actual capture metadata and the independent alternative archive evidence;
large original responses/ZIP are retained separately, not included in this fixture.

Attribution: IGN AU administrative units; derived diagnostic extract, no
institutional endorsement. [CC BY 4.0 conditions](https://www.ign.es/resources/licencia/Condiciones_licenciaUso_IGN.pdf).
The known overlap remains in both source geometries; nothing is repaired here.
